Re: A martial arts instructor from Milford Haven has has been sentenced by at Swansea Crown Court for rendering two boys unconscious by performing choke holds on them.
29 year old Grant, had been due to stand trial earlier this year charged with three offences of assault causing actual bodily harm.
But those two charges were amalgamated into one and Grant changed his pleas and admitted two offences of ABH.
